title: Head of Payments & Payment Strategy
description:
We are looking for a Head of Payments who has run payments from the merchant's seat. You have owned checkout, billing and fraud for a global online business, and you were accountable for the revenue those decisions produced.

You will own how our customers pay in every market we sell in: what the payment page looks like, which methods and currencies it offers by region, how transactions are routed and retried, and where we set the line on fraud. Success is measured in checkout conversion, approval rates, recovered revenue, fraud losses and cost per transaction.

This is a hands-on operating role. You will be in the data every day, finding where approvals drop or customers abandon, and fixing it with Product, Engineering, Finance and Risk.
You will work closely with CentroBill, our internal billing and acquiring arm. CentroBill provides the gateway, acquiring relationships and payment method coverage. You are its merchant-side counterpart: you set the requirements, review performance together and push for the routing, coverage and commercial terms the business needs. About Us
Centro is an international product company with over 20 years of expertise in product development, affiliate marketing and online technologies. Our team of 300+ professionals across Europe and North America builds products used by millions of users worldwide. What You Will Manage Daily

•
Checkout conversion by market, device, traffic source and product, from payment page load to successful charge.

•
Approval and decline rates by region, acquirer, card type and issuer, split by initial sales, trial conversions, upsells and renewals.

•
Decline reason codes , and the routing, cascading and retry rules that respond to them.

•
Payment method and currency mix in each region, so customers see the options they trust and expect locally.

•
Fraud rules and 3DS settings , watching false declines as closely as fraud losses.

•
Chargebacks, pre-dispute alerts and refunds , tracked against card scheme monitoring thresholds.

•
Recurring billing health : renewal success, failed rebills, retry schedules and involuntary churn.

•
CentroBill and provider performance : uptime, incidents, cost and the fallback when something underperforms.

Key Responsibilities
Checkout and payment page optimization

• Own the payment page experience across web and mobile: layout, form fields, method ordering, error messaging and localization.

• Add and tune express checkout options such as Apple Pay and Google Pay where they lift conversion.

• Run a continuous testing program on checkout flows and report results in conversion and revenue terms.

• Work with Product and Engineering to prioritize and ship checkout and billing improvements.

Regional payment strategy

• Decide which cards, wallets, bank transfers and local payment methods to offer in each market, based on customer behavior and unit economics.

• Set currency, pricing presentation and local acquiring strategy by region to lift approval rates and reduce cross-border costs.

• Launch payments in new markets and retire methods that do not earn their place.

Authorization and revenue optimization

• Drive improvements in authorization rates, payment conversion and transaction success rates.

• Own payment routing, cascading and retry logic across providers.

• Identify revenue leakage and fix it: soft declines, failed renewals, abandoned payments and avoidable fees.

Subscription and recurring billing

• Improve trial-to-paid conversion and renewal success rates.

• Optimize rebill timing, retry schedules, card updater and network token usage, and dunning communication.

• Reduce involuntary churn and raise payment recovery rates.

Fraud, risk and chargebacks

• Set fraud rules and 3DS strategy by region, balancing acceptance, fraud exposure and customer experience.

• Oversee chargeback prevention, pre-dispute alerts, dispute handling and win rates with Risk and Compliance.

• Keep dispute and fraud ratios within card scheme
